title: Market Literacy
intro: This level covers the arithmetic used in markets: percentages, basis points, powers, logarithms, compounding, discounting, annuities and returns. It describes stocks, bonds and funds, the main market participants, and how a trade moves from order to custody. It also covers client-account setup, double-entry posting of a trade, and the average, variance and normal curve.

units.worked_example: A EUR 25,000 portfolio pays a 0.45% (45 bp) annual custody fee = EUR 112.50. A fund that falls 20% and then rises 25% is exactly back at its start, because 0.80 x 1.25 = 1.00; falling 20% and rising 20% leaves it 4% short.

units.title: Series, sigma notation and a mixed drill round
objectives: Learner can read and expand sigma notation
